verdict.rationale: YYLO is an orchestrator for coding agents with explicit validation boundaries. Configured project checks such as tests run as explicit steps, candidates must pass renewed checks before landing, and Workflow Runner can chain an agent step into a later command step. Nothing shows YYLO itself having an agent generate tests or automatically run them as a self-validation gate before proposing a change; merge explicitly schedules no suites, so the user must wire this up. Missing for 10: agent-driven test generation, an automatic pre-proposal test-run loop, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
